R6F-deer-atv-0001.pressureWhy: No town, pavement or rec site within 1 km and not behind a closure (estimate).
R6F-deer-atv-0001.parkWhat: where the truck road ends (unnamed paved road); unload the ATV (all terrain vehicle)

evidence.t: No official deer winter range within 500 m, so the top score here is 8 of 11. This score leans on cutblocks, burns, habitat zone and aspect.
Cutblock harvested 2010 (16 years old), right here.
Burn from 2023 (fire VA1335, 2,338 ha), right here.
Habitat zone Coastal Western Hemlock (CWHds2): coast forest, where black tailed deer are among the most common large mammals (95%) and use logged ground often (80%) (lesson: Wet forests).
SW facing slope, 16 degrees: sun melts snow first.
Black bear: young cutblocks and burns grow berries in late summer and fall (Tip).

plan: Drive: from Village of Burns Lake, about 226 km (straight line times 1.3, estimate).
Park: 52.78098, -126.6449, where the truck road ends (unnamed paved road); unload the ATV (all terrain vehicle). Map links below.
Ride: 5.0 km on unnamed roads and trails by ATV (all terrain vehicle) or 4x4 on rough road, estimate. Then walk 270 m E, climb about 17 m.
Hunt: deer, Sept, Oct, Nov (season rows). Watch the edge of the 2010 cutblock (right here) at first and last light. Sit above it with the wind in your face and glass (Tip).
Use: your .308 Winchester with a 150 to 165 grain expanding bullet (Tip).
Legal: MU (Management Unit) 5-9, Region 5. Season rows below. Study aid only. The official regulations are the law.
Verify: Candidate, scout it first. Check posted signs. Private land can be unsigned. Data dates: roads 2026-10-16, private land 2026-10-02, closures 2026-10-16.

tags.why: Cover edge here (cutblock or burn): one hunter sits at a crossing or glasses, the other walks the edge slowly with the wind at their back toward the stander. Agree zones of fire, a meeting point and a time at the truck (Tip, lesson: Hunting with a partner). Pushes are on foot only (99%, synopsis page 11, item 25).

tags.label: Good solo
tags.why: Short pack out: 0.3 km and about 17 m of climb from the parking (Tip). Cell coverage is not in the data: leave a trip plan and carry SOS or a satellite messenger (lesson: Bush safety).
